response.message: Unsupported hosted file format for structure_file

root_cause_source_read_only.constants: INPUT_TYPES = (number, integer, boolean, string, stored_image); IMAGE_FORMATS = (jpeg, png); MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 20 MiB
root_cause_source_read_only.also: Reusable Files storage rejects chemical/x-cif (external Files service allowlist); hosted file outputs are listed as metadata only, structure3d visuals inline within an 8 MB result budget

decision: Not executed. No hosting resource exists; production remains on Modal and unchanged. Hosting a fixed example without user upload would not satisfy H5 (real user input) and was not attempted.
required_platform_change: Hosted invocation support for stored structure files (pdb/mmcif) or a bounded text input of at least 2 MiB, plus Files storage acceptance of chemical/x-cif and chemical/x-pdb, deployed to production with explicit approval
